n3597b2e2a88.s: CLAP (Clean Andhra Pradesh), the door-to-door segregated garbage collection programme, was launched on:
n3597b2e2a88.x: CLAP was launched on 2 October 2021 (Gandhi Jayanti), not on 15 August 2025. The dated facts here are too few for a sequence, so this is a one-liner.

n0f7679ad43f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about YSR Kapu Nestham?
o: It covers Kapu, Balija, Telaga and Ontari women
n0f7679ad43f.x: YSR Kapu Nestham gives ₹15,000 a year to Kapu, Balija, Telaga and Ontari women aged 45-60; ₹18,750 a year is the YSR Cheyutha amount.

n0e27f7437ee.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the health insurance model announced in Andhra Pradesh in May 2025?
o: It was meant only for BPL families
It offered cover up to ₹25 lakh per family per year
It was meant for about 1.65 crore families
It was announced by Health Minister Y. Satya Kumar Yadav
n0e27f7437ee.x: The model was meant for poor and middle-class families, not only BPL families.

ndd1a1486503.s: Swarna Andhra @2047 aims to end extreme poverty in Andhra Pradesh by:
ndd1a1486503.x: Swarna Andhra @2047 aims to end extreme poverty by 2030 and attain high-income status by 2047.

n40aefd9c34c.s: YSR Jala Kala in Andhra Pradesh provides:
o: Interest-free crop loans up to ₹1 lakh
Digital booking of the crop on every field
Free borewells for small and marginal farmers
Village one-stop centres for seeds and fertilisers
n40aefd9c34c.x: YSR Jala Kala gives free borewells to small and marginal farmers; e-Crop books crops digitally and RBKs are village one-stop centres.

n8b8e90e67d9.s: The net zero emissions target year in the energy goal of Swarna Andhra@2047 is:
n8b8e90e67d9.x: The net-zero target is 2047, tied to the Integrated Clean Energy Policy and APSES 2024-25, not 2035.

n22164f2d5b7.s: The Crop Cultivator Rights Card (CCRC) under the AP Crop Cultivators Rights Act, 2019 gives tenant farmers:
o: Ownership title over the leased land
Access to loans, insurance and input subsidy
Transfer of the landowner's title after five years
n22164f2d5b7.x: The CCRC gives tenants access to loans, insurance and input subsidy without affecting the landowner's title.

new.s: Stree Shakti, the free bus travel guarantee for women in Andhra Pradesh, was launched on:
new.x: Stree Shakti, a Super Six guarantee, was launched on 15 August 2025.

new.s: Free bus travel under Stree Shakti in Andhra Pradesh is available in:
new.x: Stree Shakti covers 5 APSRTC bus categories, not all buses.

new.s: Under the Super Six, Aadabidda Nidhi promises women:
new.x: Aadabidda Nidhi promises ₹1,500 a month to women.

new.s: Deepam-2 of Andhra Pradesh covers how many families?
new.x: Deepam-2 gives 3 free LPG cylinders a year to 83 lakh families.

new.s: The original Deepam scheme of Andhra Pradesh, which gave LPG connections, began in:
new.x: Deepam (1999) gave LPG connections; Deepam-2 (2024) gives free cylinders.

new.s: Nethanna Nestham of Andhra Pradesh gives loom-owning handloom weavers:
new.x: Nethanna Nestham gives ₹24,000 a year to handloom weavers who own looms.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Rythu Bharosa:
1. AP's YSR Rythu Bharosa gave ₹13,500 a year per farmer family.
2. Telangana's Rythu Bharosa gives ₹12,000 an acre.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: AP's YSR Rythu Bharosa was ₹13,500 per family (incl. ₹6,000 PM-KISAN); Telangana's scheme is ₹12,000 an acre.

new.s: YSR Rythu Bharosa of Andhra Pradesh covered which farmers besides land owners?
o: Only farmers with less than 5 acres
Only tenant farmers of Agency areas
new.x: YSR Rythu Bharosa covered farmers including tenants and ROFR holders.

new.s: From April 2024, the NTR Bharosa old-age pension in Andhra Pradesh was raised from ₹3,000 to:
new.x: The old-age and widow pension rose from ₹3,000 to ₹4,000 a month from April 2024.

new.s: Thalassaemia patients receive a monthly pension of ____ under NTR Bharosa.
new.x: Thalassaemia and similar patients get ₹10,000 a month.

new.s: The number of NTR Bharosa pension beneficiaries in Andhra Pradesh is about:
new.x: NTR Bharosa has 61.92 lakh beneficiaries.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's Family Physician programme was launched on 6 April 2023 at:
new.x: The Family Physician programme began on 6 April 2023 at Lingamguntla, Chilakaluripet, Palnadu.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the 108 service provides:
o: Mobile medical units for fixed-day village visits
Free drop-back for mothers and newborns
new.x: 108 is the emergency ambulance service; 104 runs fixed-day mobile medical units.

new.s: The Employees Health Scheme (EHS) of Andhra Pradesh provides cashless treatment to:
new.x: EHS gives cashless treatment to State employees and pensioners through the NTR Vaidya Seva Trust.

new.s: Under AP's Universal Health Policy, every citizen gets free treatment up to:
new.x: Every citizen gets ₹2.5 lakh; the poor get up to ₹25 lakh through the NTR Vaidya Seva Trust.

new.s: The first Disha police station of Andhra Pradesh was opened in 2020 at:
new.x: The Disha app and the first Disha police station were launched on 8 February 2020 at Rajamahendravaram.

new.s: In 2025 the Disha app of Andhra Pradesh was replaced by:
new.x: The Disha app, with its SOS button, was replaced by Suraksha in 2025.

new.s: The AP Disha Bill, 2019 was withdrawn after BNS and BNSS replaced the IPC and CrPC from:
new.x: BNS and BNSS replaced IPC and CrPC from 1 July 2024, not 2023.

new.s: Talli Bidda Express of Andhra Pradesh is meant for:
o: Free bicycles for Class IX girls
Taking mother and newborn home after delivery
new.x: Talli Bidda Express is a free drop-back vehicle taking the mother and newborn home after delivery.

new.s: The number of Anganwadi centres (AWCs) in Andhra Pradesh is about:
new.x: AP has 55,746 Anganwadi centres in 257 projects.

new.s: The name 'Cheyutha' was first used by a 1998 TDP scheme for:
new.x: Cheyutha first belonged to a 1998 TDP scheme for handicapped persons.

new.s: Imams and Mouzams in Andhra Pradesh receive a monthly honorarium of:
new.x: Imams and Mouzams get ₹5,000-10,000 a month.

new.s: YSR Shaadi Tohfa, under YSR Kalyanamasthu (2022), gives marriage aid to:
new.x: Shaadi Tohfa is the marriage aid for Muslims; Chandranna Pelli Kanuka gave ₹75,000 for SC inter-caste marriage.

new.s: Vidya Deevena in Andhra Pradesh is associated with:
new.x: Vidya Deevena is fee reimbursement; Vasathi Deevena is hostel/boarding support.

new.s: Mana Badi Nadu-Nedu, launched on 14 November 2019, is now called:
new.x: Mana Badi Nadu-Nedu, which upgrades government school infrastructure, is now Mana Badi – Mana Bhavishyathu.

new.s: Jagananna Vidya Kanuka (student kits) has been renamed as:
new.x: Student kits now come under Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan Vidyarthi Mitra (2024).

new.s: Door delivery of ration by mobile dispensing units in Andhra Pradesh began in:
new.x: Door delivery of ration by mobile dispensing units began in 2021.

new.s: Swachh Andhra is one of the:
new.x: Swachh Andhra is one of the 10 Sutralu; 500 ODF Plus villages were reported in January 2026.

new.s: Under Andhra Pradesh's volunteer system, one volunteer serves:
new.x: The volunteer system has one volunteer per 50 households.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about AP Village/Ward Secretariats?
o: They were India's first integrated citizen service centres
new.x: India's first integrated citizen service centres were e-Seva (2001), not the 2019 Village/Ward Secretariats.

new.s: Under the Zero Poverty P4 approach, phase 1 covered about:
new.x: P4 phase 1 covered 21.8 lakh families.

new.s: Under AP's current housing policy, an eligible homeless household in an urban area gets a house site of:
new.x: House sites are 3 cents in rural areas and 2 cents in urban areas.

new.s: APCNF (AP Community-managed Natural Farming) is run by:
new.x: APCNF, since 2016, is run by Rythu Sadhikara Samstha (RySS).

new.s: Rythu Bharosa Kendras (RBKs) of Andhra Pradesh were set up in:
new.x: RBKs (2020) are village one-stop centres for seeds, fertilisers, advisory and procurement.

new.s: Under PMFBY in Andhra Pradesh, the farmer premium for rabi crops is:
new.x: Farmer premium is 2% kharif, 1.5% rabi and 5% commercial/horticulture.

new.s: The first of the ten principles (Sutralu) of Swarna Andhra @2047 is:
new.x: The first Sutra is zero poverty, through P4.

new.s: Swarna Andhra @2047 targets a GSDP of about ____ by 2047.
new.x: The 2047 target is a GSDP of about USD 2.4 trillion and per capita income of about USD 42,000.

new.s: The Swarna Andhra @2047 vision was unveiled in:
new.x: The vision was unveiled in December 2024.

new.s: Under AP's policy suite 4.0, G.O.Ms.69 relates to the:
new.x: G.O. 68-69-70-71 = Industrial - MSME - Electronics - Food Processing.

new.s: "One Family, One Entrepreneur" is the headline goal of AP's:
new.x: The MSME & Entrepreneur Development Policy 4.0 aims at One Family, One Entrepreneur.

new.s: In AP's LIFT Policy (4.0) 2024-29, LIFT stands for:
new.x: LIFT = Land Incentive for Tech Hubs: land for big tech firms at about ₹0.99 per acre.

new.s: AP's IT & GCC Policy (4.0) 2024-29 was issued on:
new.x: The IT & GCC Policy was issued on 12 December 2024; the 4.0 industry suite on 26 October 2024.

new.s: Under AP's industrial policy, a 'mega project' is defined by:
new.x: Large is defined by capital (₹501-1,000 crore); mega by jobs (2,000+).

new.s: The investment target of AP's Industrial Development Policy 4.0 is:
new.x: Industrial Development Policy 4.0 targets ₹30 lakh crore investment.

new.s: The AP Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 2024 targets clean energy capacity of:
new.x: The policy targets 160 GW of clean energy and net zero by 2047.

new.s: Pinnapuram in Kurnool district is known for Greenko's:
new.x: Pinnapuram hosts Greenko's integrated solar-wind-pumped storage project (1,200 MW pumped storage).

new.s: The NTPC Green Hydrogen Hub in Andhra Pradesh is located at:
new.x: The NTPC Green Hydrogen Hub is at Pudimadaka (Anakapalli); foundation by PM Modi in January 2025.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, MeeSeva is a platform for:
o: Single-window delivery of government certificates and services
new.x: MeeSeva = services; BhuSeva = land records.

new.s: The Single Desk Portal of Andhra Pradesh provides:
new.x: The Single Desk Portal gives investors single-window clearances.

new.s: The Kia plant in Andhra Pradesh's Rayalaseema auto hub is in which district?
new.x: Kia = Sri Sathya Sai; Kopparthy = Kadapa; Sri City = Tirupati.

new.s: The World Bank's Phase I funding for Amaravati capital, approved in December 2024, is:
new.x: The World Bank approved USD 800 million and ADB about USD 788.8 million for Phase I.

new.s: The AP Integrated Irrigation and Agriculture Transformation Project is funded by the:
new.x: The project is funded by the World Bank (USD 172.2 million, approved October 2018).

new.s: The AP Farmer Managed Groundwater Systems (APFAMGS) project was supported by:
new.x: APFAMGS (2004-09) was an FAO project in which farmers managed groundwater demand.

new.s: Which pair of agencies funds Phase I of the Amaravati capital?
new.x: Amaravati Phase I is funded by the World Bank and ADB, about USD 1.6 billion in all.

new.s: Bhogapuram airport (Alluri Sitarama Raju International) is in which district?
new.x: Bhogapuram airport is in Vizianagaram district, built by GMR on PPP.

new.s: Mulapeta port is located in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Mulapeta port is in Srikakulam district.

new.s: The port limits of Ramayapatnam port were reduced to 15 km from:
new.x: Ramayapatnam was cut from 51 km and Machilipatnam from 64 km, both to 15 km.

new.s: Polavaram is a national project under which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
new.x: Polavaram is a national project under Section 90 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014.

new.s: The Bulk Drug Park of Andhra Pradesh is located at:
new.x: The Bulk Drug Park (2,002 acres) is at Nakkapalli, Anakapalli; foundation January 2025.

new.s: Since June 2026, APIIC can allot industrial land without Cabinet approval up to:
new.x: Since June 2026 APIIC allots up to 50 acres without Cabinet approval.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Giri Gorumudda – Free bicycles to Class IX girls
Talli Bidda Express – Taking mother and newborn home
new.x: Talli Bidda Express takes mother and newborn home; Badikosta gives bicycles and Giri Gorumudda gives tribal nutrition.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the AP Disha Bill, 2019:
1. It proposed investigation in 7 days.
2. It proposed trial in 14 days.
3. It amended the BNS and BNSS.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Bill set 7 days for investigation and 14 for trial (21 days) and amended IPC and CrPC, not BNS/BNSS.

new.s: Which of the following old and new scheme names is wrongly matched?
o: YSR Pension Kanuka – NTR Bharosa Pension
new.x: Jagananna Vidya Kanuka became Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan Vidyarthi Mitra; Amma Vodi became Talliki Vandanam.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Anna Canteens in Andhra Pradesh:
1. A meal costs ₹5.
2. 62 rural canteens were opened at Dharanikota (Palnadu) in April 2026.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Anna Canteens serve ₹5 meals; 62 rural canteens opened on 15 April 2026 at Dharanikota, taking the total to 269.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Annadata Sukhibhava?
o: The State share is ₹6,000 a year
new.x: The ₹20,000 is ₹14,000 State plus ₹6,000 PM-KISAN; the State share is ₹14,000.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: YSR Aasara – Repaid women SHGs' bank loans outstanding on 11 April 2019
new.x: YSR Aasara repaid SHG loans outstanding on 11 April 2019; Cheyutha was ₹18,750, SERP is rural and MEPMA urban.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of AP policy 4.0 and G.O. is correctly matched?
new.x: G.O. 68-69-70-71 = Industrial - MSME - Electronics - Food Processing.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about PMFBY in Andhra Pradesh:
1. It has been voluntary for all farmers since Kharif 2020.
2. The farmer premium for kharif crops is 5%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: PMFBY is voluntary for all since Kharif 2020; the kharif premium is 2%, while 5% applies to commercial/horticulture crops.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Amaravati capital?
o: The Singapore partnership for the Start-Up Area was formed in 2014
The foundation stone was laid by PM Narendra Modi
APCRDA was set up under the APCRDA Act, 2014
Its foundation stone was laid on 22 October 2015
new.x: The Singapore consortium partnership for the Start-Up Area was formed in 2017, not 2014.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Bhogapuram is in Vizianagaram; Machilipatnam is in Krishna, Mulapeta in Srikakulam, and Polavaram is on the Godavari.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about AP's Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0:
1. It targets USD 50 bn production.
2. It targets USD 10 bn investment.
3. It targets 5 lakh jobs.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The policy targets USD 50 bn production, USD 10 bn investment and 5 lakh jobs.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about AP e-governance initiatives?
o: e-Seva (2001) was India's first integrated citizen service centres
BhuSeva assigns a Bhudhaar to each land parcel
MeeSeva is the integrated land-records platform
new.x: MeeSeva delivers services; BhuSeva is the land-records platform.
